description: We are The Rovers, a team passionate about space exploration. Inspired by real NASA rovers like Curiosity and Perseverance that adapt and solve problems on Mars, we built an interactive app that lets you run your own space mission. In our app, you make the key decisions ,from designing life support prototypes to taking care of the crew's well-being, to see if you can successfully carry a space mission.
summary: Our project is about going on a space mission and allowing players decide their fate by their decisions in the game. We developed this game using scratch with closing blocks and our own avatars. We think it’s important because not a lot of people truly understand what its like to be out in space with real missions, real research, and real lives at stake.  Please check Scratch.com and search for “Orbiting Fate" by The_Roverz for full game with coding.
details: Our project shows you how it would be like to make real decisions in space and how it can affect your future choices. It works by code, using building blocks on scratch we managed to let people adverse option to choose their character and to have their own decisions. We can all benefit by putting our feet in other peoples shoes, like astronauts, and using our own tactical thinking to decide how a mission should play out. Our team considered the multiple outcomes of this project, since many people have many different opinions, everyone would be able to get different outcomes based on how detailed our coding is, but we wanted it to be played by people of all ages.Please check Scratch.com and search for “Orbiting Fate" by The_Roverz for full game with coding.
